condition.center_m: three finite JSON numbers in metres

occurrence: first detected nondegenerate local root only
max_step_s: positive, duration/10000 <= value <= duration; second search halves it
min_distance_m: positive measurement-validity threshold, not softening or collision radius
initial_stationarity: reject zero/unresolved radial speed; do not skip launch root
result: state time, position, velocity, speed, energies, distance, radial speed, radial acceleration; SI units and actual extremum
no_event: no detection in two searches, not absence proof
validation: strict complete-packet validation before evaluation; local runtime errors preserve valid requests
limits: Multiple within-step roots can be missed; refinement is not completeness or global-error certification.
